tasks.title: Seamless migration where all 24 models, 12 enums, 40+ indexes, relations, and seed data are preserved. API contract unchanged. Type-check...

1) Static: deno check passes on apps/api/src/main.ts and apps/web/src/main.tsx. deno lint and deno fmt --check pass. Zero @prisma/client imports remain. 2) DB: drizzle-kit generate produces valid SQL. Migration applies cleanly to fresh PostgreSQL. Seed script runs without errors. All 24 tables have correct row counts. 3) Functional: GET /health and /ready return correctly. Register, login, create recipe, fork, like, comment, follow, badge evaluation, admin stats all work. 4) Tests: All existing test suites pass (they mock DB layer or test logic, so minimal changes needed). 5) Deployment docs updated.
Write or update tests for all new and changed behavior
Update documentation for all public-facing changes (README, API docs, CHANGELOG)
